title: XML entity shapes for file read and out-of-band confirmation
prerequisites: an XML parser that resolves external entities
a document you control reaching that parser
excerpt: External entity support turns a document into a read or a fetch primitive. In-band shapes return file content inside the parsed document; out-of-band shapes make the parser contact a listener you control, which is what proves parsing when the response gives nothing back. Record which shape the parser accepted, because hardened defaults usually reject both.
